title: sundogcert: A machine-checked 3SAT ≤ 3DM ≤ X3C ≤ syndrome-decoding hardness chain in Lean 4
description: An axiom-clean Lean 4 / mathlib formalization of the reduction-correctness spine of the classical Karp chain 3SAT ≤ 3DM ≤ X3C ≤ bounded-weight GF(2) syndrome decoding, each link proved as a both-directions equivalence, together with the syndrome-certificate core it lands on and a build-enforced axiom-cleanliness gate that pins every headline theorem to Lean's three foundational axioms. The repository additionally carries related Lean method-demonstration modules (real-analysis shadow decay, halo minimum-deviation geometry, Aharonov–Bohm gauge invariance). Reproducible by lake build (Lean v4.30.0, mathlib v4.30.0). Accompanies the paper Mechanising the Hardness of Syndrome Decoding.
